dimensions.name: Age
dimensions.description: Use the age ranges published by the source. A minimum joining age is eligibility, not the average age of users.

dimensions.name: Gender
dimensions.description: Keep the source’s categories and population. A product aimed at women does not establish its female user share.

dimensions.name: Location
dimensions.description: Keep rural, urban, semi-urban, metropolitan and tier-based figures distinct. Branch location is not user residence.

dimensions.name: Employment
dimensions.description: Record salaried, self-employed, student or other groups only where the source identifies them. Loan applicants and UPI users are separate populations.

dimensions.name: User type
dimensions.description: Separate individuals from businesses, merchants and retail agents. This is customer segmentation, not an individual demographic.

notes: Reported users, intended audience and eligibility are separate fields.
Missing figures remain missing; ages, percentages and income are not estimated.
Every reported figure retains its period and population. Registered users, active users, borrowers and merchants are not interchangeable.
The uploaded August 2026 table contains transaction figures, not user demographics.
Bank rows may combine multiple apps. Demographics for all customers of a bank are not assigned to its UPI app users.
National surveys provide context only; their results are not assigned to individual apps.
The dimensions are this study’s structure. Source age bands are preserved rather than forced into new bins. Income and education can be added where app-specific data is available.
Multiple audience tags describe separate published statements; they do not establish joint demographic counts.
Audience labels can describe a named product or assisted service rather than every user of an app.

sources.title: Annual Report 2025–26: Payment and Settlement Systems, paragraph IX.10
sources.supports: The nationwide survey examines digital-payment adoption by age, income, gender and location, and treats merchants separately from users.

sources.title: Comprehensive Modular Survey: Telecom, 2025
sources.publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
sources.supports: National survey context for age, sex, rural/urban residence and ability to perform online banking; these are not individual app user shares.

sources.title: Guidelines for Identifying Census Centres
sources.supports: Defines bank-centre population groups. These definitions are retained as source context, not substituted for a user-residence classification.

sources.title: Exploring behavioral intentions of consumers towards different digital payment services through the interplay of perceived risks and adoption factors (2025)
sources.supports: A primary UPI survey records age, gender, occupation and monthly income. Its overall sample demographics are not cross-tabulated app-user demographics.
